selected_factors.name: LOW_REF
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PROX_INTRADAY_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks closing near both their five-day low and the intraday low are deeply oversold, making a next-day rebound more likely.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PROXIMITY_RANGE_STABLE
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their 5-day low are more likely to mean-revert if the recent intraday range is narrow, because low volatility near the support level indicates exhausted selling pressure rather than a panic breakdown.

selected_factors.name: MA
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: INTRADAY_LOW_CLOSE_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks that repeatedly close near their intraday low are short-term oversold and tend to rebound the next day, adding information beyond the multi-day low support ratio.

selected_factors.name: HIGH_REF
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: LOW_HIGH_RATIO_5
selected_factors.reason: A high ratio of the recent 5-day minimum low to maximum high signals tight consolidation near recent highs, capturing momentum and support that predicts a positive next-day return.

selected_factors.name: LOW_SUPPORT_VOLUME_STABILITY
selected_factors.reason: Stocks near their recent lows with stable trading volume are more likely oversold without panic selling, leading to favorable next-day price reversal.

selected_factors.name: CLOSE_QUANTILE_10_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: A stock trading near the lower decile of its 20-day price distribution is oversold and tends to mean-revert upward in the Chinese A-share market, so the ratio should have positive next-day rank IC.

selected_factors.name: LOW_REV_VOL_STABLE
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their 5-day low with stable, non-accelerating volume are oversold without panic confirmation, so the low is more likely to hold and produce a reversal.

selected_factors.name: VOL_SPIKE_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Short-term reversal is stronger after volume spikes because overreaction and crowded trades are more likely to unwind, so high-volume past declines should outperform.

selected_factors.name: LOG_TREND_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: A stock that is below its own 20-day log-linear price trend is oversold and tends to mean-revert upward, so the negative residual predicts higher next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: LOW_CLOSE_SURGE
selected_factors.reason: A sudden jump in the proximity of the close to its 5-day low flags an intraday capitulation that tends to reverse upward next day, and the EMA subtraction isolates the new shock rather than the stock's prevailing low-price level.

selected_factors.name: TREND_DEVIATION_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: Stocks closing below their short-term linear trend are likely to mean-revert upward next day, so a negative five-day OLS residual predicts higher returns.

selected_factors.name: NEAR_LOW_VOLUME_CONTRACTION
selected_factors.reason: Stocks near their 5-day low with shrinking volume reflect selling exhaustion and are more likely to bounce next day, improving rank IC.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_STABLE_VOLUME
selected_factors.reason: Stocks closing near a multi-week low with stable volume are more likely to have exhausted selling pressure and rebound next day.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_VOLUME_DRYUP
selected_factors.reason: A stock pinned near its 5-day low with shrinking volume indicates exhausted selling pressure, so the expected bounce is stronger; combining proximity-to-low with the inverse of the short-term volume ratio isolates this dry-up reversal signal.

selected_factors.name: LOW_PRICE_RANGE_POSITION_STABILITY
selected_factors.reason: Stocks trading near their 5-day low with a stable intraday close position (no consistent trend in where close falls within the daily range) are oversold and likely to mean-revert next day.

selected_factors.name: IMIN
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: NEAR_LOW_VOLUME_BOOST
selected_factors.reason: A close near the 5-day low accompanied by above-average volume signals panic-driven capitulation that tends to mean-revert the next day, whereas quiet declines are less reliable, improving the cross-sectional rank IC.

selected_factors.name: DRY_VOLUME_AT_SUPPORT
selected_factors.reason: Price pressing the recent low while volume dries up to its 5-day minimum signals exhausted selling pressure, making a low-volume rebound more likely next day.

selected_factors.name: KUP2
selected_factors.reason: Official AlphaBench Alpha158 seed.

selected_factors.name: DOWN_VOLUME_SHARE_20
selected_factors.reason: A larger fraction of total volume on intraday down days signals panic-driven selling, and short-term contrarian reversal in A-shares should make this positively predict next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: LOW_QUIET_TAIL
selected_factors.reason: Cheap stocks near their recent lows with a narrow high-volume tail are less susceptible to panic selling and tend to revert upward next day.

selected_factors.name: RECENT_HIGH_PROXIMITY
selected_factors.reason: Stocks that remain close to their 20-day high, especially when that high was set recently, exhibit short-term momentum that predicts higher next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: FIVE_DAY_DRAWDOWN_REVERSAL
selected_factors.reason: A large drop from the close five days ago to the recent five-day low marks an oversold short-term drawdown that tends to be followed by a next-day rebound in A-shares.

selected_factors.name: NEG_RET_VOL_CORR
selected_factors.reason: Heavy volume on down days signals panic-driven overselling, and the resulting short-term reversal should boost next-day returns.

selected_factors.name: SUPPORT_AND_SILENT_RANGE
selected_factors.reason: A stock whose recent lows are close to its price and whose intraday range shows low correlation with volume suggests stable, unobserved accumulation rather than noisy distribution, predicting a better next-day return.

selected_factors.name: 5D_LOW_VOLUME_CORR
selected_factors.reason: Stocks closing near their 5-day low tend to bounce, especially when the close-volume correlation is weak, suggesting the decline is driven by low-conviction flow rather than sustained selling pressure.

selected_factors.name: LOWER_SHADOW_LOW_VOLUME
selected_factors.reason: A long lower shadow combined with shrinking volume signals exhausted selling pressure and likely next-day reversal.
